mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in continued monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market weakness that triggers central bank policy easing, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: The interaction of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profit visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals early monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as higher borrowing costs pressure corporate valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly employment growth above 100,000 jobs (PAYEMS) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 jobs per month.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 235), declining retail sales (RSAFS) signals reduced consumer purchasing power, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS declines and CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 800,000 units (HOUST) signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST falls below 800.0.
